messages:
Priya K: FYI PR #5423 CI turned red on linux/integration (flaky network test). Can't repro locally. Is there a way to resubmit just that job without rebuilding the docker image? image build is ~20m. @Alex T any quick command?

Alex T: yep — you can retry the specific job from Buildkite UI -> job -> Retry. If you want to do it from Slack/CLI we have the ci-bot command: 

ci-bot: `/ci rerun --pipeline=redwood-build --build=5423 --jobs=integration-linux --no-image`

(use `--no-image` to avoid re-running the image build step; it tells the pipeline to skip the image job and reuse the existing artifact)

Jonah: if this is GitHub Actions instead try: `gh run list --workflow integration.yml` then `gh run rerun <run-id>` and you can pick the failed job from the UI. but for our Buildkite flows use ci-bot above.

Priya K: thanks, trying that now.

ci-bot: Accepted. Rerun queued: pipeline=redwood-build build=5423 jobs=integration-linux flags=[no-image]. ETA ~2m.

Maya R: small tip — if reruns keep failing with the same flaky test, add `ARTIFACT_CACHE=off` env on the rerun to force a fresh workspace, sometimes sticky caches cause network flakes. e.g. 

```
/ci rerun --build=5423 --jobs=integration-linux --no-image --set=ARTIFACT_CACHE=off
```

Priya K: rerun succeeded, tests passed. thanks all :tada:

Alex T: nice. if it flips again, we can bisect the range with the ci-bot: `/ci bisect --since=main~8 --until=HEAD --job=integration-linux` — it'll run a binary search across commits to find the PR introducing the flake. use sparingly.

Priya K: noted. I'll leave a note on the PR and follow up with flaky-test label. 

Jonah: re: docs — I'll add a short section to the infra runbook with the exact ci-bot flags (`--no-image`, `--set=...`, `--jobs=...`) so folks don't have to dig.

Priya K: perfect, thanks everyone!
